_notes: status: built = a Jinja template exists under factory/templates, has been rendered for a Stonehurst variant and passed qa.py; mock-only = exists only as hand-written HTML in previews/stonehurst or previews/lindley-scott-house (registered in the fingerprint registry, not yet ported to a template); spec = defined here and in docs/venue-site-factory.md, no template yet. The selector only ever picks 'built' items.
axes use the same 0-100 scale as pairings.json. Missing axes are 'don't care'.
needs lists photo requirements the selector checks against the content photo manifest (min source width for the lead photo, number of photos, orientation).

Stage 2A (2026-10-20): status planned-2B = specified in docs/research/05-luxury-dialects-spec.md and owed by stage 2B (factory/STAGE-2B-CONTRACT.md); planned_stage=2B on a mock-only/spec item means 2B ports/builds it. Template existence on disk is the source of truth at build time (lib/templates.py); these labels are refreshed by `python3 lib/templates.py --refresh`. heroes[].fingerprint.hero_framing is one of inset/bleed/type/silent/split/crest (fingerprint dimension). `sections` lists rhythm blocks that dialects place by id.
dialect_only: true = never offered to pre-dialect (--dialect none) builds, so the three Stonehurst proof variants select exactly what they did before stage 2A.
